==Notes==
* This item is required by [[Imperial Chef Chen]] for his main course at the annual [[Canthan New Year]] festival. 
* [[Collector Terra]] trades 7 Unctuous Remains for a scroll that sells for 400 {{gold}} to a merchant and at least 400 {{gold}} to a [[rare scroll trader]]. This provides a return of 190% compared to just selling the trophies by themselves.
** You may want to salvage them for dust however, as the crafting material is usually in high demand due to being required to craft [[Essence of Celerity|Essences of Celerity]].
